services.name: Jet Skis
services.desc: Jet ski tours are our favorite way to explore the local waters. With a local guide in the lead, you’ll go in search of hidden islands and pods of playful dolphins. The tour is set to the pace of those participating and aims to provide an exciting adventure for all ages. Special requests can be made at the time of booking for particular areas of interest and destinations. Common Destinations of interest: Shell Key Wildlife Preserve, Bunce’s Pass Sandbar, John’s Pass Sandbar, Ft. DeSoto State Park.
